train: Original train except all reserved localization workers; only utterance, intent and BIO supervision enter training
development: Original dev except all reserved workers; adaptive development already consumed in previous attempts
reservation: Original test and all reserved workers remain unused until development gates justify a frozen audit
algorithm: Greedy averaged perceptron with hashed word/context/affix/shape features and previous predicted BIO tags, gold intent conditioning at training. Learned weights quantized and pruned by magnitude per head, not learned exact rules or general mathematical certificates.
selection: Exact structured dev matches, then fewer stored nonzero weights, then policy order
metrics: Exact intent and all ordered role/value spans; novelty strata; all errors and abstentions in denominator. Margins are not probabilities or authority.
completion_contract: evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json; all gates must pass before M1 approval or M2
scope: Known empirical algorithm, not a novel AGI claim. Corpus labels supply role semantics; no language-specific vocabulary, pretrained weights or LLM teacher. Source/localizer limits and unknown RSS/energy remain. Stored previous predictions labeled as historical controls.
